wish: someone should make a cat simulator game from the perspective of a cat
spec:
A cozy top-down apartment where you are the cat: knock the mug, vase, plant and shelf mug off for chaos points, sit in the box and on the laptop, nap in the moving sunbeam, run 3am zoomies, stare at nothing.
Drag or tap the floor to walk, tap an object to swat it, or tap a goal on the checklist to go there; sound starts on your first tap.
The human sleeps on the couch and sometimes wakes: if they see you knock something or sprint, you lose stealth; no levels, no saving except your best score.
